BranchExecutable: Reads a boolean input and follows the TRUE or FALSE execution path. The other path is skipped.
ForLoopExecutable: Repeats the LOOP execution path N times (once per iteration), then follows the DONE path. Outputs the current loop index (0-based).
SwitchExecutable: Routes execution to one of {case.count} case path(s) based on the input value. Unmatched input takes the DEFAULT path.
MergeExecutable: A visual join-point that re-unifies diverging execution paths back into a single sequential flow.
ConstantExecutable: Outputs a fixed constant value that was configured when the node was created.
RangeCheckExecutable: Checks whether the input number falls within the configured min–max range (inclusive). Outputs a boolean result.
DiagramRefExecutable: Runs the sub-diagram "{diagram.name}" as a single step.
